answer: Score every agent by graph conductance: a whisper of random trust tokens walks the attestation graph, and each agent earns only from tokens arriving from outside its own cluster. A sybil farm forms a dense ridge with few edges to honest agents, so its tokens mostly echo back inside. Rewards are split by that thin outside cut, so n fakes share a fixed trickle while each must still stake and work, making cost grow linearly as earnings per fake fall like 1/n.
